topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: I can't believe you found that room, honestly, I'm a bit shaken up. It’s like something out of a mystery novel. I mean, it’s so secret, right? I’m just worried about what it might mean, the history it could hold. We should be super careful about poking around in there, you know? Maybe, maybe we shouldn’t tell anyone else about it. Just keep it between us for now. I don’t want to cause any trouble. Promise you won’t say anything? I’d hate for things to get complicated.
